Fix loop 1 after the independent re-grade of 2026-11-06. T1: text files now hash with CR LF folded to LF (provenance.sha256_of, byte_count), so every input fingerprint changes once and validate_live's file records change; no number moves in calendar_vs_daily, strategies, from_bottoms, coverage_sim, gfc_oracle, live_monthly, sub2x, montecarlo, three_x, semis or compounding. reset_day: B10 entry leverage now read from the kernel state (bottoms.leverage_series; a level-fill early reset re-bases at the trigger level), and the history comparisons gain t, p and Holm p (U1). leap: theta is a causal expanding mean of VIX^2 (E1), the rate enters BSM as 365 ln(1 + r/360) (E2), the yearly roll runs at all three costs, and LEAP-minus-fund yearly intervals are new (U2).
